title: Collaboration was named in 77% of instructional design job ads, more than any other skill
subtitle: Share of 1,030 US instructional design job announcements naming each skill, collected September to October 2019
notes: US ads from one month in 2019; LinkedIn listings weren't included. The ratios are a fair guide to what employers value; tool names will have moved on.

sources.label: Wang, Chen, Ritzhaupt & Martin (2021), International Journal of Training and Development
